mentions.name: acgo
mentions.description: An AI coding agent tool written in Go that accepts natural-language instructions, lets an LLM interpret intent, and executes coding work through tools such as file read/write, code search, and terminal commands. It exposes hooks and monitors the agent's working lifecycle so a harness can constrain the agent's behavior, with the agent acting as the smallest execution core and the harness acting as its execution agent.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://github.com/vince-0202/acgo

Over the past few weeks, I have been building an AI coding tool in Go. The core loop is straightforward: accept a natural-language instruction, let the LLM interpret intent, then execute coding work through tools such as file read/write, code search, and terminal commands.
